posts.text:
I was offered the chance to say it on national television, and what I said was: I can't, because I did not, and do not, want to see my country fail.
But it's nice to have people notice when your warnings were right. If I'd been wrong, I'd have heard about it plenty.
posts.summary: Rejects calls to support country's failure under current leadership
